scenarios.rationale: With valid ct the destination is only the owner-stored URL; u is used only via the legacy safe_dest(u) fallback pinned to the site host. Unit test test_foreign_u_never_used.

scenarios.scenario: Owner stores a foreign URL for a site-host type
scenarios.rationale: 422 at write time and re-checked at redirect time; test_site_host_type_rechecked_at_redirect + integration 422 cases.

scenarios.scenario: HTML injection via stored CTA URL/label into outbound email
scenarios.rationale: URLs pass validate_booking_url (rejects < > " ' ) and whitespace) + https; labels reject the same chars; email embeds only the server-built /c/ wrapper.

scenarios.scenario: Forged tp stamps clicked_at on another tenant's touchpoint
scenarios.rationale: tp must belong to a campaign of the path site_id; integration test_foreign_site_tp_ignored.

scenarios.scenario: Encrypted _bid leaked to a third-party booking host
scenarios.rationale: _bid/_tp appended only for site-host CTA types; book_demo redirects to booking_url untouched.
Only site_id, cta_type, campaign_id, timestamps; logs carry cta_type + site_id only.

scenarios.scenario: Click-count inflation by anyone holding a site_id
scenarios.rationale: Accepted named residual (D): public endpoint, 120/min/IP rate limit; click-level counts, not conversions.
